content.title: Blood pressure and anaemia screen
content.body: Your blood pressure was estimated at 128/84 mmHg. Your haemoglobin is 7.4 g/dL, which is low. This is a screening signal and not a diagnosis. A normal range sits below 120 over 80. Please see a doctor within 7 days to confirm both readings with proper equipment and a blood test.
recommendations: Book a blood test within 7 days.
Ask your doctor for a cuff blood pressure reading.
